description: Anti-forgery state defaults and satisfied-requirement. With NO config object the default policy enforces state, so a grant-code request that omits it is redirected with invalid_request / 'The state parameter is required'. When state IS supplied under an explicit enforce_state policy, the same request succeeds with a freshly issued code and echoed state.
